title: question_request — a question typed in the console, written as typed (plan.md 4.5)
description: What the console's question window writes into its own folder, console/requests/questions/. It is not an ask: ask.schema.json is the bridge's envelope. It holds the asker's words verbatim, the asking login and that login's console-side role, the time, and the agent addressed if one was chosen. It makes no claim that the asker is the person's own: that claim counts only with a proof no session can forge (plan.md 4.5, 6.2), which is not built, so a reader treats every request as another login's (plan.md 15.1). Nothing reads a request until the agents' new inbox, designed on its own and approved by the person, opens (Q-20261022-office-04). No secret goes in, so no object admits a key it does not name.

id.description: qr-<UTC date>-<UTC time>-<four random characters>; also the file's name.

words.description: The question exactly as typed. Nothing rewrites it, and autocomplete only ever inserted strings the asker accepted.

login.description: A plain login id, never an email, in the same pattern as plan_approval's signed_through.login.

console_role.description: What this login may do inside the console when it asked (Q-20261022-office-06). Recorded for the agents to honour; the console enforces none of it on an agent.
